Container.Name: claude-in-container
Container.Overview:
Always-on Claude Code in tmux, reachable from phone or browser via Remote Control. Claude sees only the Workspace folder.
Before installing: clone the repo and run CONTAINER_ENGINE="sudo docker" scripts/build.sh. Create the Workspace and Home folders owned by the user in Extra Parameters (default --user 99:100), e.g. mkdir -p DIR && chown 99:100 DIR; Docker would otherwise create them root-owned.
First start: open the console (or: docker exec -it claude-in-container tmux new -A -s main) and log in with your Claude subscription. The login persists in the Home folder.
Container.Requires: Image built locally with scripts/build.sh from the project repository.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: The only host folder Claude can see and edit, e.g. /mnt/user/projects

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: Keeps the Claude login and settings across restarts

Config.Name: Remote Control name
Config.Description: Session name shown in the Claude app; empty = container hostname

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional; use instead of the subscription login. Disables Remote Control (subscription-only)
